headline: A quick check can complete the picture
body: A free blood pressure check is available at most pharmacies in England if you're 40 or over — no appointment needed. Knowing your numbers will help complete your assessment, and you may also be eligible for a free NHS Health Check.
next_step: Pop into a local pharmacy for a free blood pressure check.
